calc_concrete_slab.title: Concrete Calculator
calc_concrete_slab.summary: Cubic yards, bags, truck loads and weight for a slab, with multiple sections and an optional thickened edge.

calc_concrete_cost.title: Concrete Cost Calculator
calc_concrete_cost.summary: Your own delivered price per cubic yard applied to the quarter-yard order quantity, with short-load fee, delivery, and bags against ready-mix.

calc_rebar.title: Rebar Calculator
calc_rebar.summary: Bar count each way, lap splices carried into the total length and into the order, stock bars packed into 20, 40 or 60 ft, weight, intersections and supports, for a slab grid or a continuous footing.

calc_gravel.title: Gravel Calculator
calc_gravel.summary: Cubic yards, short tons and metric tonnes of gravel, stone or rock, with a sourced density, the compaction conversion and a truck count.

calc_fill_dirt.title: Fill Dirt Calculator
calc_fill_dirt.summary: Cubic yards, tons and truck loads of fill dirt, in or out, with the loose and in-place rows of a cited federal exhibit and no compaction applied unless you ask.

calc_sand.title: Sand Calculator
calc_sand.summary: Cubic yards, short tons and a 50 lb bag count for sand, with the dry, damp and wet rows of a cited table and a screeded bedding depth.

calc_topsoil.title: Topsoil Calculator
calc_topsoil.summary: Cubic yards, bags, weight and coverage of topsoil for a lawn, a top-dressing pass, a garden bed or a raised box, with the published depth of each job and the soil already on the ground subtracted.

calc_cubic_yard.title: Cubic Yard Calculator
calc_cubic_yard.summary: Cubic yards, cubic feet and cubic meters over up to four areas of mixed shapes, the area a volume covers, the dug-versus-delivered swell, and bags and truck trips from your own sizes.

calc_asphalt.title: Asphalt Calculator
calc_asphalt.summary: Short tons and metric tonnes of hot mix for up to three compacted courses over four areas, with a cited in-place unit weight and the spread rate a paving quote is written in.

calc_board_foot.title: Board Foot Calculator
calc_board_foot.summary: Board feet for up to four lumber sizes on one order, with the whole-board-foot order quantity, lineal feet, pieces, cost per board foot and per 1,000, an optional nominal-versus-dressed volume, and the piece redrawn from what you typed.

calc_roofing.title: Roofing Calculator
calc_roofing.summary: Squares, shingle bundles, underlayment rolls, ridge cap and starter for up to four roof sections, from the plan footprint and the pitch, with every yield read off a named manufacturer sheet.

calc_roof_pitch.title: Roof Pitch Calculator
calc_roof_pitch.summary: One slope written four ways and solved back from any of them — rise in 12, angle in degrees, grade in percent and the slope factor — plus the ridge height and the common rafter length once a span is typed.

calc_fence.title: Fence Calculator
calc_fence.summary: Posts by type, rails, pickets, gates and post-hole concrete from one line: gate openings come off first, corners divide the run, and the hole is counted less the post standing in it.

calc_duct.title: Duct Calculator
calc_duct.summary: Round and rectangular duct size from airflow and your friction rate or velocity limit, rounded up to a size you can buy with velocity and friction recomputed, what a duct carries, and a reducing trunk sized after each branch.

calc_paver_base.title: Paver Base Calculator
calc_paver_base.summary: Crushed stone base, bedding sand and the excavation depth under a paver patio, driveway or street, with the minimum base thickness for each traffic class read off a masonry association's own application guide.
